explanation: Fires only at the D1 step, and only in the last few trials of the episode (about trial 95 to 99), when the trial just before had a rare transition. It is usually 7 to 10 when that rare trial went unrewarded, around 7 when it was rewarded, and lower (2 to 4) when the trial before that was also rare; it is 0 at GO, at D2, after common transitions, and at every step earlier in the episode.
